designs.Mara: a woman in her early thirties, exhausted, dark brown hair tied back loosely, a grey oversized cardigan over dark pyjamas, no jewellery; Caucasian, light skin, early thirties as noted. A thin, wiry build and a weary rectangular face with tired, sensitive hazel eyes. Her dark brown hair is chin-length, slightly wavy, and always tied in a low, loose, messy ponytail with flyaways. Her cardigan is a true, warm charcoal grey, and her pyjama bottoms are a faded navy blue cotton. No makeup, no jewellery.
designs.Lily: a four-year-old girl with messy fair hair, pale yellow pyjamas with small stars; Caucasian, fair-skinned. A slight, small-framed four-year-old with a soft, round face, a small mouth, and large, clear blue eyes. Her fine, straight hair is a pale honey blonde, just past her shoulders, and perpetually tousled. Her star pyjama top and bottoms are both the same specific shade of pale, faded lemon-yellow. Never wears hair clips or accessories.
designs.The Storyteller: a tall, gaunt man of indeterminate age in a long, worn charcoal coat and a wide-brimmed hat, his face mostly in shadow except for pale, kind, tired eyes; he always carries an old iron lantern whose flame burns blood red

places.name: Lily's Bedroom
places.design: A child's small, simply furnished bedroom in an older suburban house. Walls are painted a matte, faded cream. The flooring is dark-stained wide-plank wood. A low white table holds a plastic star-shaped night-light (cool white glow). A single sash window has pale yellowed curtains. Against one wall is a simple wooden bedframe with headboard. A star-patterned blue duvet is crumpled on it. A functional black plastic baby monitor sits on a small, cheap wooden bedside table. The only constant light at night is the weak, focused glow from the star night-light.

places.name: Mara's Bedroom
places.design: An adult's sparsely decorated master bedroom. Walls are a flat, cool grey. The flooring is the same dark wood as the rest of the house. A simple double bed with a dark grey duvet sits centrally. A plain, unadorned wooden bedside table stands to one side, its surface occupied only by the black plastic baby monitor receiver. The sole light source at night is the faint, ambient sodium-amber streetlight glow seeping through a thin, off-white blind on the single window, which casts long, deep shadows.
